scripts.dev: concurrently --names chatbot,improver,ui --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "pnpm run dev:chatbot" "pnpm --filter improver dev" "pnpm --filter ui dev"
scripts.dev:chatbot: uv run uvicorn server:app --app-dir apps/chatbot --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir apps/chatbot
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm -r check:types
scripts.format: uv run ruff check --fix . && uv run ruff format .
